guard: status reports the persona root a bare spawn will actually use and marks divergence from the folder
why: TWO MUTATIONS cover both status guards: the selected spawn root and loader-valid launchability.
Assigning spawnRoot from folder makes the
comparison agree by construction even when the selected mesh points elsewhere, recreating the
false status card that advertised the folder's default persona as if spawn could launch it.
The mutation is compile-clean and leaves target resolution intact. The counting smoke continues
through the full matrix and must redden the exact cell that requires the selected mesh's catalog
path to appear: `divergent: the spawn root is named too`.
The second mutation restores existence-only default reporting inside the SHIPPED status renderer.
It keeps listPersonas/loadAgentFile live but discards its error at the final capability decision,
so the exact B1 file state returns: a present `default.md` that spawn rejects is painted green.
The named invalid-default cell must kill it; the repaired positive control uses a loader-valid file.
